items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, now day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team will monitor how he feels this week before Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Harbaugh update after exiting Week 1 early
items.implication: Monitor practice; risk of missing or limited Week 2
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for other LAC WRs if limited/out

items.text: Malik Nabers active in first game post-ACL/meniscus (late decision); 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), team-high 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0, emerged healthy.
items.why: Post-game tracking; late pregame decision per Schefter
items.implication: Positive return; volume share elite even on limited snaps, ramp-up expected
items.opportunity: High target share; start with confidence ROS

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending. Coach confirms DTD.
items.implication: Likely available or close for Week 2; low long-term concern
items.opportunity: If out, Bateman/Lane (Lane also wrist) upside

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere owned—would not activate if major injury concern (Cardinals caveat). ETR had expected to play.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with some risk

items.text: Lions offense extremely concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.implication: Core four locked-in every-week starts; fade others in DET
items.opportunity: Massive snap/target/carry share for the four

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7 targets all caught) but sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy; strong Week 2 matchup vs CLE.
items.implication: Solid RB2 with TD upside; healthy confirmation positive
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone and route work over Gainwell

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays; buying low everywhere possible. Preseason belief in Bears offense intact.
items.opportunity: Elite route share in CHI offense

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak now considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week’s meniscus trim.
items.why: HC update indicating faster recovery path
items.opportunity: If out again, Michael Mayer continues elevated role

items.text: With Alvin Kamara (knee) out, Travis Etienne did not fully dominate: snaps Etienne 53 / Kendre Miller 26 / CJ Donaldson 15; routes 24/7/5; opportunities 18/9/4.
items.why: Post-game snap/route/opp tracking; ETR noted Kamara status impacts Etienne proj
items.implication: Etienne RB2/flex but not automatic dominate; Miller handcuff relevant
items.opportunity: Etienne still primary; monitor if Kamara returns or role expands

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway.

Sunday injuries watching: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), Chig Okonkwo (hamstring), Dylan Sampson (knee), Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist), Omar Cooper (ankle).
items.implication: Key Week 2 status trackers; Lane wrist multi-week likely

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers everywhere despite possible decoy risk after late active decision.
Dalton Kincaid appears over PCL issue: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Josh Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
items.opportunity: High route participation in Bills offense

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially active (ETR expected to play calf).
items.implication: Full go for Week 1; continue monitoring
